query:
-- Vérifier outOfPackageMinutes du résident
SELECT id, firstName, lastName, outOfPackageMinutes 
FROM residents 
WHERE id = 1;

-- Forfait actuel
SELECT id, totalHours, usedHours, isActive 
FROM packages 
WHERE residentId = 1 
ORDER BY createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 1;

-- Dernier pointage
SELECT id, packageId, checkInTime, checkOutTime, durationMinutes 
FROM attendances 
WHERE residentId = 1 
ORDER BY createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 1;
